basic_details.scholarship_name: United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) PhD Full Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) College of Graduate Studies
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: United Arab Emirates University Main Campus (Al Ain, Abu Dhabi Emirate, UAE)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all PhD programs across College of Engineering, College of Information Technology (CIT), College of Science, College of Agriculture and Veterinary Medicine, College of Medicine and Health Sciences, College of Business and Economics, and College of Education.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~40 to 60 prestigious fully funded PhD scholarships awarded annually across all colleges
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani doctoral scholars represent a prominent contingent (~5 to 10 awards annually in computing, engineering, and sciences)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 4 years (48 months) of full-time doctoral research, subject to satisfactory annual research progress

nationality_requirements: Open to outstanding national and international applicants globally (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No formal age limit; evaluated on academic and research excellence.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A Master's degree (18 years education) from an HEC-recognized university with an outstanding academic record (minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.70+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum Master's CGPA of 3.50 / 4.00 or equivalent; strong Bachelor's record (minimum 3.00 / 4.00) also required.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Relevant Bachelor's and Master's degrees in the applied research discipline.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Master's students in their final semester can apply conditionally with expected graduation certification.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Substantial research experience, first-author journal publications (Scopus/Web of Science), or conference presentations strongly prioritized.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (with minimum 6.0 in each skill), TOEFL iBT minimum 79, or EmSAT English score of 1550+. Official test score is mandatory.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants apply for the PhD Scholarship during the general UAEU online graduate admissions application process.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold any concurrent fellowship or employment without explicit university approval.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver for the complete 4-year doctoral candidature (AED 120,000 to 180,000 total degree value).

admission_application_fee.details: UAEU graduate admissions application fee of AED 200 (~USD 55; ~PKR 15,200) paid online.

accommodation.details: Free furnished on-campus housing provided in UAEU graduate residence halls in Al Ain, or housing allowance (for married students with approval) of up to AED 1,500 / month.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living stipend: AED 6,000 / month (~USD 1,630 / month; ~PKR 456,000 / month) for single students; up to AED 7,500 / month (~USD 2,040 / month; ~PKR 570,000 / month) for students eligible for package enhancements.

airfare.details: Initial one-way flight ticket to the UAE and return flight ticket upon graduation provided under the international student package.

visa_fee.details: UAE Student Residence Visa sponsorship, medical examination, and Emirates ID card fees arranged and fully funded by UAEU.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive health insurance policy (Daman National Health Insurance) covering medical, inpatient, outpatient, and emergency care in the UAE.

food_allowance.details: On-campus food court and diverse dining options; monthly living costs easily covered from the AED 6,000/month stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Comprehensive access to UAEU National Library, scientific computing resources, and state-of-the-art research laboratories.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Financial support for research project consumables and international conference attendance (up to AED 3,000 per conference).
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to AED 3,000 conference travel grant

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free university campus shuttle service operating across all campus sectors in Al Ain.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (United Arab Emirates University, Al Ain)
participating_institutions: United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) - UAE National Flagship (Al Ain, Abu Dhabi, UAE)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #261 worldwide, Times Higher Education #301-350, #1 comprehensive research university in the UAE.
available_majors: PhD in Computer Science and Information Technology
PhD in Chemical and Petroleum Engineering
PhD in Materials Science and Engineering
PhD in Horticultural and Agricultural Sciences
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Online UAEU graduate application, research proposal, Master's and Bachelor's transcripts with minimum CGPA 3.50/4.00, official IELTS/TOEFL score report, two academic letters of recommendation, CV, and interview.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: College of Information Technology and College of Engineering receive the highest volume of international applications; having an identified UAEU professor supporting your research proposal is decisive.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Reach out to potential faculty advisors at UAEU before applying. Align your proposed doctoral topic with UAE national priority research sectors (artificial intelligence, water security, renewable energy, and space exploration).

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: UAEU College of Graduate Studies Online Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on the UAEU Graduate Admissions Portal, select the PhD program, tick the option for the 'Full PhD Scholarship', and upload all academic credentials.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Contact potential doctoral supervisors at UAEU to discuss research proposal alignment (October - December).
Step 2: Take IELTS (min 6.5) or TOEFL (min 79) and obtain official test report.
Step 3: Register on the UAEU Graduate Admissions portal and complete the online application.
Step 4: Upload Bachelor's and Master's degrees, transcripts, research proposal, CV, and passport copy.
Step 5: Pay the application fee of AED 200 online via credit card.
Step 6: Referees submit recommendations directly through the automated UAEU referee portal.
Step 7: College Graduate Studies Committee reviews applications and conducts video interviews (February - April).
Step 8: Final admission and scholarship award decisions announced (May - June).
Step 9: Complete UAE student visa formalities, receive flight booking, and matriculate at UAEU in August.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Track: The PhD scholarship application is embedded directly within the online graduate admission process.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via secure automated links generated upon application fee payment.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose detailing academic background, research objectives, rationale for choosing UAEU, and post-PhD career goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 3 to 5-page doctoral research proposal outlining problem statement, literature review, research questions, methodology, and expected timeline.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications (with DOI and indexation status), research experience, and awards.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 30-minute online video interview via Microsoft Teams with a departmental faculty panel evaluating research competence and proposal feasibility.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 6.5) or TOEFL iBT (min 79) mandatory; GRE optional but recommended for engineering applicants.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts must be attested by HEC Pakistan, MoFA, and the UAE Embassy in Islamabad upon final admission offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation required for any documents not in English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the UAEU graduate admissions portal.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Master's and Bachelor's Degrees and Transcripts
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts and degrees with minimum Master's CGPA 3.50/4.00.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC Pakistan with official grading scale explanation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed 3-5 page research proposal outlining research methodology and novelty.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Synergy with UAEU research centers (e.g. Zayed Center for Health Sciences, Emirates Center for Energy and Environment) strongly advised.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (min 6.5 with 6.0 in all bands), TOEFL iBT (min 79), or EmSAT 1550+.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Test report must be valid within 2 years of application.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential evaluation letters from academic professors who taught or supervised the applicant.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be sent from official institutional email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed CV including copies of published journal/conference papers.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight papers indexed in Scopus or Web of Science.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Color copy of passport identification page valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have validity through late 2028.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake is Fall semester (commencing August). Highly competitive selection process.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Prior journal publications, proposal quality, and research match)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: College Graduate Studies Committee, Departmental Review Panel, and Dean of the College of Graduate Studies.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase evaluation: academic credential and publication review followed by departmental faculty video interview.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~40 to 60 full PhD scholarships awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4.0% among competitive applicants with published papers
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Master's CGPA 3.70+ / 4.00 from leading Pakistani universities (NUST, QAU, GIKI, PIEAS, FAST, UET)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with at least 1-2 published papers in Scopus-indexed journals and a well-developed research plan aligned with UAEU priority areas.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani top engineering, computer science, and life science programs.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: UAE, Pakistan, Egypt, India, Jordan, Iran, Nigeria, Algeria, Lebanon.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of unsolicited emails or third-party agencies claiming to provide guaranteed UAEU scholarships.
Applications are processed exclusively through uaeu.ac.ae.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: UAEU charges an official AED 200 application fee paid directly via the university portal; never pay agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: UAEU does not authorize any educational agents for scholarship recruitment.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Degree attestation in Pakistan (HEC and MoFA) and UAE Embassy legalization: ~PKR 35,000 to 45,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: The PhD scholarship is only open to UAE citizens. Reality: UAEU PhD Full Scholarships are explicitly open to top international candidates globally.
Myth: You do not need published papers. Reality: Given extreme competition, having at least one peer-reviewed publication significantly elevates your admission probability.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial portals claim GRE is mandatory; GRE is optional for most UAEU PhD programs.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.00 in doctoral coursework throughout candidature.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time on-campus presence and commitment to research, including fulfilling required Graduate Teaching Assistant (GTA) duties (up to 6 hours per week).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reports reviewed by the supervisory committee and the College of Graduate Studies.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may not hold external employment during the scholarship tenure.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory return requirement; graduates are eligible for UAE Golden Visas (PhD holders category) or global careers.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship terminated if student fails the comprehensive examination twice, fails to make research progress, or engages in academic misconduct.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major changes are generally not permitted once admitted to the PhD program.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship duration is strictly capped at 4 years (8 semesters); extensions beyond year 4 must be funded by research grants.
